meta.title: Fast-Slow Manifold Geometry and Richardson Number Dynamics in the Stable Boundary Layer
meta.subtitle: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Automated Diagnostic Report
meta.abstract: We present an automated LaTeX template populated directly from our Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data model. The framework maps Single Column Model (SCM) trajectories onto the exact fast-slow critical manifold and dynamic fold locus $\mathrm{Ri}_{\mathrm{fold}}(T_s)$.

ri_fold_overlay.title: State-space trajectory overlay of SCM output against the dynamic GSPT fold locus $\mathrm{Ri}_{\mathrm{fold}}(T_s)$ and transcritical activation threshold $\mathrm{Ri}_{\mathrm{trans}}$.
